QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Beldar's Letter
QuestInfo.0: #bBeldar#k, in Pantheon, wants to talk to you. The long-awaited operation to reclaim Heliseum is finally beginning...
QuestInfo.1: Beldar says they need more power to reclaim Heliseum. He asks you to deliver a letter to the #bCygnus Knights#k in #bMaple World#k. As far away as they are, they might cooperate against a common enemy...
QuestInfo.2: The Cygnus Knights were also asked to help reclaim Heliseum. How will they reply?

0.0: Are you doing well in Maple World, Kaiser? This might feel abrupt, but it's finally happening... #bOperation Free Heliseum#k. We're going to take back our capital from Magnus.
0.1: Of course, it's not going to be easy. Magnus is a powerful enemy, and we're not entirely prepared. However, we must take a stand... This isn't something we can keep delaying. Even if we have to recover Outrigger, the holy relic protecting the Nova.
0.2: We are asking for help from all our allies, as even a little more aid could make the difference. I was wondering if you could deliver a letter to the #bCygnus Knights#k in Maple World. As far away as they are, they might cooperate against a common enemy...

yes.0: I leave this to you. I hope it works out.

no.0: Do you have another idea? Don't be shy.

1.0: It's been a while, Kaiser. What brings you to Ereve?
1.1: This is...a letter? It's a letter from the Nova Council. Please wait while I review this.

yes.0: An operation to reclaim the capital of the Nova... I understand the situation. However, this is not something I can agree to on my own. I must discuss this with the other members of the Alliance. There will be a meeting soon, and I think you should join as well, Kaiser.

npc.0: Deliver a letter to the #bCygnus Knights#k in Maple World. They are in #bEreve#k.

item.0: It's been a while, Kaiser. What brings you to Ereve? Do you have something for me?

lost.0: You lost the letter? It's rare for you to make such a mistake. I'll give you another one. Hurry and take it to Ereve.
